strings.en: Oh, welcome back, everyone.
We're back, Jun. What about the Federation work crew...?
They initialized Uribatake's dummy program and went home.
...Huh? What happened to Captain Amuro and the others?
Oh, Captain Quattro said the crew would make a fuss if they found out
everyone was on the Nadesico, so they left right away.
The Getter Team got an emergency call from the Saotome Laboratory,
so they rushed back.
Kabuto and Boss seemed kinda reluctant to go, though...
Ho ho ho, it seems the open-air bath will have to wait.
But Captain Quattro's right.
It looks like we'd better pull out soon too.
It seems Nergal owes Londo Bell... strictly speaking, its surface unit...
quite a large debt.
Not at all. We all help each other in times of need.
I certainly don't, and I doubt they think of it as a debt either.
That's our Dr. Hazuki... I mean, Commander! So generous!
Captain, your wording's a little off...
Still, I never figured adjusting a computer would be such a pain.
Yeah, more than a game... it was a real battle.
Came for a bath, got a battle... a bath-tle debug... heh heh...
Who'd have thought images of the enemies people fixate on
would come out of their minds as they accessed it... So many Jovian mechs...
The first ones appeared because they were the foes Omoikane knew best.
But after that...
It seems they were the enemy images carved most deeply
into whoever was accessing it, in their current state of mind.
So that means... that Einst...
That big lug, huh...
So out of all of us, that's the one that made the deepest impression?
Averaged across everyone... I suppose you could say that.
Kyosuke seemed pretty bothered by it.
Hmm... In any case, the Nadesico can return to duty. That's good news.
Let's prepare all ships for launch.
Yes, Commander Hazuki!
Well, everyone, see you later!
Aw, I like the Nadesico better. There's so many places to play.
It seems... people have trouble seeing her as a state-of-the-art battleship.
Perhaps the facilities were too luxurious...
I think the problem is the people aboard, not the facilities.
Doctor! What's this about calling us back so suddenly...?
...Wh-What is this...!?
...Shin Getter Robo.
Shin Getter Robo!?
He calls us back out of nowhere...
and he's been building this? That's sneaky of you, Doctor.
...No. This is a freak child... born from the Getter Reactor experiment.
...A freak child?
The other day... the lab was attacked by those Einst series things, yes?
Yeah... Because we were useless...
we let that Einst bastard into the base...
Then the Getter Reactor went haywire and the test was called off...
Yes. With a runaway Getter Reactor, there's no telling what could happen...
I intended to seal it off along with that whole block of the lab, but...
Then... this is Getter-1...!?
Yeah... I can see the resemblance.
Its Getter readings are back to normal.
...I want you to put it to use in the battles ahead.
I-Is it safe, Doctor?
Inside, it's mostly the same as the old Getter... The startup tests are done.
Understood... Shin Getter... I'll master it!
We're heading back to the Gran Garan, Hayato, Benkei.
Let's run a performance test on Shin Getter-2 on the way back.
You got it.
Ryo... Be careful of that enemy called the Einst series.
Huh...?
Getter Rays are the energy of life... I continue my research believing that.
If this incident was no accident...
and they can interfere with that energy of life...
Interfere... with the energy of life...?
...then they're something completely unlike any enemy so far...!
Perhaps... the most crucial key to this war...
is held by them.
Good grief, what a job that was.
Don't say that, Tetsuya. It was kinda fun, wasn't it?
Anyway, glad the Nadesico's fixed. And we drove off the Campbellians.
...Didn't finish them off, though.
It looks like they fled Earth. I confirmed that much.
Still, it ain't sittin' right with me.
We still don't know how these Einst guys are tied in.
And Excellen...
Juzo!
Oops. ...Kyosuke, it's all right. Excellen's...
Yeah... I believe in her.
Kyosuke... They'll stand in our way to the very end.
So...
Yes... Soon... without fail...
Anyway, when's old man Hazuki coming back?
He's not planning to camp out on the Nadesico, is he...?
Then the nag won't be hanging around us. What's wrong with that?
Too bad, Shikibu.
Whether it's the Gran Garan or the Elshank, unless I'm aboard the ship
that's been kind enough to take you in, I can't rest easy.
Ugh, figures...
Thank you, Commander Hazuki. Where do we go from here...?
About that... I'd like to consult with Captain Bright up in space.
Indeed, I'm curious about the situation in space too.
Right. While we talk to Captain Bright, everyone check your machines.
Yeah. We meant to come right back from the Nadesico, but it ran long...
I wonder how everyone up in the sky is doing.
Lady Sheela, way, way up above the sky, it's night all around.
So it seems... Far above Byston Well lies the surface.
And above it, endless night... with humans waging war in every one...
How sad.
Lady Sheela...
Such is the karma of man... One day, it must be cast aside...
(This person... is different from the others...)
(Char... Are you still up to something...?)
The Goraon has joined the Gran Garan? Is this true?
Yes. In addition, two surface battleships have gathered with them.
Lord Drake, we have only the Wil Wiph... Perhaps we should...
No matter. Hold this course. We will strike down Sheela and Elle.
But...!
Enough, Shot Weapon.
I'll not be told how to wage war by a mere engineer like you.
...Ngh... But Lord Drake, do you have some strategy in mind...?
Sheela Lapana and Elle Hamm... petty tricks won't work on them.
We push in head-on... Shot, now that they've joined up,
will they split up again before bringing down the Wil Wiph?
Then we have no choice but to strike before they grow used to battle.
Our only chance of victory is now.
I understand... Forgive me for speaking out of turn.
If you understand, good... This battle decides our fate. Steel yourselves!
Yes, my lord!
Haman?
Yes. It seems she's begun to move.
...For now it's just skirmishes, and Judau's group and Rom's group
can handle them well enough, but...
No telling what happens from here on.
Exactly. Restoration of Luna II and Konpeito is crawling along...
so the Federation's chain of command is still in chaos.
I never relied on the Federation brass in the first place.
Harsh, man. ...But I can't argue with that.
Basically, a few of our machines oughta head up to space, right?
Bright?
That's right... There's also some troubling information.
...We've had reports of a machine that looks like the Weissritter up here.
What!?
It only just showed up at the Saotome Laboratory the other day...!
It's not confirmed yet... but it's a distinctive machine,
so it's unlikely to be a mistake...
Captain Amuro, please put me in the unit going to space!
Oh, me too, please. ...I have to tell Domon about Kyoji...
How is he?
...He still needs complete rest, but... he said to hang in there...
All right.
Bright, we'll send some back up on the HLV Banjo's group came down in.
Hold out until then somehow.
Right. I'm counting on you.
Transmission ended.
The Meganoids now active on the surface, the Einst... and Excellen...
Lots to worry about... but first, Drake's army.
...Drake...!
Lady Sheela, don't you know where Drake is?
Lady Sheela?
I'm not sure whether to be glad about this, but... it's the Wil Wiph.
Whew. Good timing.
It seems... they were looking for us as well.
Then shall we grant their wish and head out, Commander?
Right, all hands, battle stations! Notify the other ships at once!
Drake...! You mean to beat us and conquer the surface too...!?
